verdict.rationale: TypeSafe documents an official agent skill, installable as a Claude Code plugin through the marketplace and described as a drop-in for Claude Code, Codex and other agent environments. It also ships first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs, so the coding-agent half of the story is clearly delivered. The agent-framework half is not documented: there are no official integrations for agent frameworks, only generic client SDKs and a changelog note about AI-gateway examples. missing for 10: documented official integrations with agent frameworks (framework-native tools/adapters), independent hands-on corroboration of the skill/plugin working in coding agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support

citations.quote: Drop-in skill for Claude Code, Codex, and other agent environments.
The TypeSafe agent skill gives your AI coding agent full context on the TypeSafe API
Our client SDKs provide typed questions and answers for the TypeSafe API and handle retries automatically with their default retry policy.
